programmes.d: Rachel backs a woman who says her ex-husband molested their daughter, but Tony has to arrest the woman for taking the girl from her ex, who has custody.
Vinnie is drawn into a plot to destabilize the Japanese economy led by Admiral Strichen and General Leland Masters.
After the funeral of the assassinated economist Andrew Valenti, Vinnie accelerates his investigation into the covert plot behind the professor's murder.
The pieces of the diplomatic puzzle begin to come together for Vinnie as General Masters puts the final touches on his plot to make Vinnie the fall guy.
While investigating the apparent suicide of Hunter's friend from the Vietnam War, the pair uncovers a 20-year-old betrayal that is still killing people today.

McCall finds her loyalties sharply divided when an important murder case being prosecuted by the Assistant District Attorney, with whom she is in love, is jeopardized by Hunter.
Stan hopes to make sergeant by busting a suspected drug dealer, who may be marked for death by his own wife (Leah Remini).
Stan's killer says Rachel and Tony are marked for death by a hit man whom no one has ever seen.
Tony is shot and enlists the help of a physiotherapist to help him walk again. While he is out, Cyd is put in charge of the murder investigation of a police officer.
As the search for a cop killer intensifies, Tony begins to doubt his own recovery.
In a Senate executive session, a falsely accused Vinnie is systematically stripped of his honor, even as Masters' diabolical scheme is exposed.
When a cantankerous Mike McPike is asked to leave his nursing home — the latest in a string of them — he "retires" temporarily to the home of his son Frank.
